title: WorkerReviewRunRequest
description: The body of the worker's POST /review: which finished run to review, and the reviewer's verdict. A worker keeps no review store, so the review is sent inline; the worker forwards it to the backend's POST /runs/{id}/reviews along with the caller's bearer token, which attributes the review to the authenticated account. Submitting a review does NOT publish the run — push (POST /push) releases and stores it privately, review attaches an assessment, and publish (POST /publish) flips it public once it has at least one review. A missing or invalid rating is a `422`; a missing bearer token is a `401`; an unknown run is a `404`.

runId.description: The id of a run this worker previously produced and pushed. Its record is loaded from the worker's output directory.

ratings.description: The reviewer's quality rating for each of the test case's declared scoring domains. Within this review the overall is the worst across them; the run's overall rating is the worst across every review.

writeup.description: The markdown writeup body shown before the playable build, with any rating and checklist frontmatter stripped. Must be non-empty.

checklist.description: The reviewer's verdicts on the test case's declared reviewer checklist items (see the version manifest's reviewItems). One entry per declared item; a review must give every declared item a verdict. Empty or omitted for a case that declares no items.
